title: Sermon on the Mount Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Sermon on the Mount Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Sermon on the Mount Bible crossword: salt of the earth, light of the world, the lilies of the field, the house on the rock. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Three chapters, and most of the sayings anyone can quote. Sermon on the Mount ranges over all of Matthew 5 to 7 — salt and light, the city set on a hill, the lilies of the field that toil not, the strait gate, and the two houses built on rock and on sand.
The Beatitudes and the Lord's Prayer both sit inside this sermon and both have puzzles of their own; this grid takes everything around them. It closes on the line about the city that cannot be hid.

clues.text: A city set on one cannot be hid
The wise man built his house upon it

verseText: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
